facts.text: All students must complete an Experiential Learning Requirement through an approved course, internship, research project, community service, or study abroad.

sources.title: Experiential Learning Graduation Requirement
sources.quote: Students complete the Experiential Learning Requirement by completing one (or more) of the following: An experiential learning course (listed in the General Education section of the University Catalog); An internship, co-op, or practicum
